title: Truncated exponential Gaussian tilt transferred through the moderate-deviation window

tilt_trial.profile: Fix smooth chi with 0<=chi<=1, chi=1 on [-3/2,-1/2], supp(chi) subset [-2,0], and set u_N(x)=exp(-R_N x/2-R_N^2/4) chi(x/R_N)
tilt_trial.gaussian_identity: Without the cutoff, u_N(Z)^2 is the likelihood ratio of N(-R_N,1) relative to N(0,1)
tilt_trial.stieltjes_transfer: Integration by parts writes every truncated exponential moment as endpoint terms plus a positive integral of P(X_N<=-z); K1513's uniform logarithmic tail ratio transfers it multiplicatively
tilt_trial.cutoff_norm: E[u_N(X_N)^2]=1+o(1) because the plateau captures probability 1-o(1) under the tilted N(-R_N,1) law
